setlist_extra.title: 5 seconds between Tom Thumb's Blues and Brown Eyed Women

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Just Like Tom Thumb's Blues** (3 reviews): Phil sang it, his first solo lead vocal with the band in nearly twelve years, and the first live version; First Phil solo vocal in ten years, on a Dylan song [28][34][36]
- **Mississippi Half-Step Uptown Toodeloo** (1 review): Brought back after a three-year absence [36]
- **Brown Eyed Women** (1 review): Phil's Tom Thumb's start cut off Jerry's intro to this song [28]
- **Shakedown Street** (1 review): Played with lots of energy [29]
- **Playing In The Band** (1 review): Hard, fast and psychedelic, with a late passage the reviewer hears as a nuclear attack [29]
- **Touch Of Grey** (1 review): Reviewer calls it a train wreck, but an interesting one [35]

## Setlist highlights

- **Mississippi Half-Step Uptown Toodeloo**: back after 158 archived shows (892 days) [40]

## The recordings

- **gd1985-03-27.audiotec.damico.87209.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 18 songs; 126 min; rated 2/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1985-03-27.164915.sbd.remaster.shnid8567.clugston.flac16**: soundboard; 17 songs; 130 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd85-03-27.sbd.ladner.8567.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 17 songs; 128 min; rated 3.5/5 by 16 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer preferred the audience copy to this soundboard, since the crowd should be heard; Soundboard seems pitched too fast at first listen, but the band really plays fast; show runs under two hours; Very good sound quality; fast tempos throughout the show [32][33][35]
- **gd85-03-27.aud.vernon.7369.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 17 songs; 132 min; rated 4.25/5 by 3 [4]. Said about its sound: Audience recording sounds pretty good; the soundboard is pitched too fast [36]
- **gd1985-03-27.149304.senn441.hunt.mattes.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 17 songs; 131 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [5]
- **gd1985-03-37.170910.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 17 songs; 128 min [6]

## Around the show

- Mid-week, non-sellout crowd; reviewer on the floor saw many fans confused, wondering whether a guest singer had joined [28]
- Reviewer notes how the band interacted with the crowd at this show [31]
- Floor was general admission, which surprised the reviewer for Nassau [33]
- Reviewer's first birthday show; heard the tapes via Grateful Dead offices [37]
- Reviewer thinks this show is overshadowed by 3/28; second set is short but very well played [29]
- Reviewer acknowledges many consider the next night, 3/28/85, the strongest of the run [37]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1985-03-27.audiotec.damico.87209.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Joe D'Amico; transferred by Joe D'Amico; source: audio tech mics > sony d5 > mac [1]
- **gd1985-03-27.164915.sbd.remaster.shnid8567.clugston.flac16**: source: Master Soundboard Cassettes > Cassettes > DAT > CDR (shnid8567) [2]. Also: Patched, pitch-corrected, channel-corrected remaster of shnid8567; A Nakamichi 304 source supplies a 23-second patch in Playin' In The Band [2]
- **gd85-03-27.sbd.ladner.8567.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD> MC> C> DAT> CDR> WAV> SHN [3]
- **gd85-03-27.aud.vernon.7369.sbeok.shnf**: source: PCM AUD (unknown taper/mics)> PCM> DAT> CDR(1)> SHN, big thanks to David Minches for the seed (had been marked unknown aud); via Scott Zarnegar; Matt Vernon [4]
- **gd1985-03-27.149304.senn441.hunt.mattes.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Rob Hunt and Ted Mattes; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Rob Hunt and Ted Mattes' Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 441 mics > Sony D5M [5]. Also: Oade Schoeps source supplies some crowd, the start of Brown Eyed Women, and a 25-second Drums > Space patch [5]
- **gd1985-03-37.170910.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Michael Hessberg; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Michael Hessberg's Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser ME-80 mics > Sony D5M [6]. Also: Oade Schoeps source patches 36 seconds of Space and 28 seconds of Stella Blue [6]
